channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Final-round tee times moved up due to weather at Pebble Beach
item.description: Due to inclement weather forecasted for Sunday afternoon on the Monterey Peninsula, PGA Tour officials have moved up Sunday’s final-round tees times for the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am. Here's how to watch.

item.title: Scottie Scheffler unbothered as top-10 streak in jeopardy at Pebble Beach
item.description: Scottie Scheffler has made the top 10 in 17 consecutive PGA Tour tournaments, a streak that could be broken at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am. The No. 1-ranked player won't go quietly though. Scheffler posted a bogey-free 67 on Saturday.

item.title: Redemption time? Akshay Bhatia leads at Pebble Beach, site of all-time bad break
item.description: Bhatia leads the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am entering Sunday's final round, eight years after a bizarre penalty likely cost him a victory at the U.S. Amateur at Pebble Beach.

item.title: Bhatia: 'Brutal' to see ball wobble on 18 as weather impacts play late
item.description: Akshay Bhatia was bogey free through 45 holes at the 2026 AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am. On the back nine, Bhatia battled the elements and bogeyed twice. He enters Sunday's final round with a two-stroke lead over three players.

item.title: 'Absolute carnage': Pebble Beach winds wreak havoc at end of Round 3
item.description: Golf Central recaps the playing conditions at the 2026 AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am. During the final hour of play, winds reached as high as 30 miles per hour as players finished the third round.

item.title: Akshay Bhatia leads with high winds and rain forecast for Sunday at Pebble Beach
item.description: Bhatia is two shots clear of three others at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am, where weather is expected to significantyly worsen for the final round.

item.title: Player thoughts, Tour plans for a windy Sunday at Pebble Beach
item.description: With high winds and rain forecast for Sunday at the 2026 AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am, Todd Lewis explains the PGA Tour's final-round plans and what players are anticipating.

item.title: Moving Day: Morikawa irons lift him to T-2 at Pebble Beach
item.description: Collin Morikawa enjoyed his career-best round at Pebble Beach Golf Links, shooting a 10-under 62 on Moving Day to put himself in contention for the PGA Tour's first signature event of the season.

item.title: Collin Morikawa goes low and proves, for the first time in a while, he's here to win
item.description: Sparked by a shift in mindset, Morikawa fired a 10-under 62 Saturday, his best round in over a year, and sits two back entering the final round of the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am.

item.title: PGA Tour Highlights 2026: AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am, Round 3
item.description: Akshay Bhatia carries a two-stroke lead over Collin Morikawa, Jake Knapp and Sepp Straka heading into the final round of the 2026 AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am. In addition to the tournament leaders, Sam Burns, Rory McIlroy and Scottie Scheffler provided some amazing Round 3 highlights.
